item.title: Hamas plot to massacre Jews in Europe on Oct. 7 anniversary foiled
item.description:
Germany's federal prosecutor has revealed that a Hamas-organized plot to massacre Jews and Israelis in Europe – timed to the October 7 anniversary – was foiled at the last moment. Nine suspects have been arrested across the continent, and a separate Iranian assassination plot targeting Jewish leaders in Germany was also stopped, in part through Mossad intelligence.

item.title: Report: Trump deal hands Iran instant oil revenue
item.description:
Iran will be permitted to resume oil and fuel exports immediately upon the signing of the Trump-brokered ceasefire agreement, The Wall Street Journal reported. The sanctions waivers extend to banking, shipping and insurance services needed to facilitate the sales. A senior US official said sustained relief would remain contingent on Iran's compliance with US demands on the Strait of Hormuz and its nuclear program.

item.title: Russian warship fires warning shots at yacht in English Channel
item.description:
The British military has launched an investigation after a Russian warship fired warning shots at a UK-registered yacht in the English Channel, roughly 20 miles south of the Isle of Wight. No injuries or damage were reported. The incident follows the seizure of a suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker in the same waters two days earlier.
